arxiv-2110-02153.title: Inference and De-Noising of Non-Gaussian Particle Distribution Functions: A Generative Modeling Approach Thanks: Partially Supported by Department of Energy Grant 17-SC-20-SC
arxiv-2110-02153.creator: 1 st John Donaghy, 2 st Kai Germaschewski
arxiv-2110-02153.description: Abstract The particle-in-cell numerical method of plasma physics balances a trade-off between computational cost and intrinsic noise. Inference on data produced by these simulations generally consists of binning the data to recover the particle distribution function, from which physical processes may be investigated.

arxiv-2202-04306.title: Can Open Domain QA Models Answer Visual Knowledge Questions?
arxiv-2202-04306.creator: Jiawen Zhang, Abhijit Mishra, Avinesh P.V.S, Sachin Agarwal
arxiv-2202-04306.description: Abstract The task of Outside Knowledge Visual Question Answering (OKVQA) requires an automatic system to answer natural language questions about pictures and images using external knowledge. We observe that many visual questions, which contain deictic referential phrases referring to entities in the image, can be rewritten as “non-grounded” questions and can be answered by existing text-based question answering systems.

arxiv-2205-10832.title: Multi-dimensional Kuramoto-Sivashinsky-Zakharov-Kuznetsov equation posed on admisssible multi-dimensional domains Thanks: MSC 2010:35Q35; 35Q53. Keywords: Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation; Zakharov-Kuznetsov equation; Global solutions; Decay in bounded Domains
arxiv-2205-10832.creator: N. A. Larkin
arxiv-2205-10832.description: Abstract . An initial- boundary value problem for the n-dimensional ( n n is a natural number from the interval [2,7]) Kuramoto-Sivashinsky-Zakharov-Kuznetsov equation posed on smooth bounded domains in ℝ n {\mathbb{R}}^{n} was considered. The existence and uniqueness of global regular solutions as well as their exponential decay have been established.

arxiv-2212-04279.title: Application of machine learning regression models to inverse eigenvalue problems
arxiv-2212-04279.description: Abstract In this work, we study the numerical solution of inverse eigenvalue problems from a machine learning perspective. Two different problems are considered: the inverse Strum-Liouville eigenvalue problem for symmetric potentials and the inverse transmission eigenvalue problem for spherically symmetric refractive indices.

arxiv-2401-10023.title: A first approach to the Burchnall-Chaundy theory for quadratic algebras having PBW bases Thanks: The authors were supported by the research fund of Faculty of Science, Code HERMES 53880, Universidad Nacional de Colombia - Sede Bogotá, Colombia.
arxiv-2401-10023.creator: Arturo Niño, María Camila Ramírez, Armando Reyes
arxiv-2401-10023.description: Abstract . In this paper, we present a first approach toward a Burchnall-Chaundy theory for the skew Ore polynomials of higher order generated by quadratic relations defined by Golovashkin and Maksimov [ 30 ] . 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 11E88, 16S36, 16S37, 16W50, 17A45 1.

arxiv-2404-02230.title: A Mixed Methods Study on the Implications of Unsafe Rust for Interoperation, Encapsulation, and Tooling Note: This material is based upon work supported by the U.S. Department of Defense under Grant No. H98230-23-C-0274 and the Sponsor National Science Foundation http://dx.doi.org/10.13039/100000001
arxiv-2404-02230.creator: Ian McCormack, Tomás Dougan, Sam Estep, Hanan Hibshi, Jonathan Aldrich, Joshua Sunshine
arxiv-2404-02230.description: Abstract . The Rust programming language restricts aliasing to provide static safety guarantees. However, in certain situations, developers need to bypass these guarantees by using a set of “unsafe” features. When these features are used incorrectly, they can reintroduce the types of safety issues that Rust was designed to prevent.

arxiv-2410-13925.title: FiTv2: Scalable and Improved Flexible Vision Transformer for Diffusion Model
arxiv-2410-13925.creator: ZiDong Wang, Zeyu Lu, Di Huang, Cai Zhou, Wanli Ouyang, and Lei Bai
arxiv-2410-13925.description: Abstract Nature is infinitely resolution-free . In the context of this reality, existing diffusion models, such as Diffusion Transformers, often face challenges when processing image resolutions outside of their trained domain. To address this limitation, we conceptualize images as sequences of tokens with dynamic sizes, rather than traditional methods that perceive images as fixed-resolution grids.

arxiv-2505-01510.title: Trivalent network model for d 3 transition metal dichalcogenides in the 1T structure: Holography from local constraints
arxiv-2505-01510.creator: Ashland Knowles, R. Ganesh
arxiv-2505-01510.description: Abstract Dimer models are well known as prototypes for locally constrained physics. They describe systems in which every site on a lattice must be attached to one dimer. Loop models are an extension of this idea, with the constraint that two dimers must touch at each site.

arxiv-2507-19553.title: Theoretical modeling and quantitative research on aquatic ecosystems driven by multiple factors
arxiv-2507-19553.creator: Haizhao Guan, Yiyuan Niu, Chuanjin Zu, Ju Kang
arxiv-2507-19553.description: Abstract Understanding the complex interactions between water temperature, nutrient levels, and chlorophyll-a dynamics is essential for addressing eutrophication and the proliferation of harmful algal blooms in freshwater ecosystemsalgal. However, many existing studies tend to oversimplify thse relationships often neglecting the non-linear effects and long-term temporal variations that influence chlorophyll-a growth.

arxiv-2509-00759.title: Integration of promising piezoelectric and photocatalytic properties in Janus In X ​ Y XY ( X X = S, Se, Te; Y Y = Cl, Br, I) monolayers and their heterojunctions
arxiv-2509-00759.creator: Xinyue Liu, Ziqiang Li, Yanfeng Ge, Yong Liu, Xing Wang, Wenhui Wan
arxiv-2509-00759.description: Abstract Two-dimensional (2D) Janus materials show great promise as piezoelectric materials and photocatalysts for water splitting. In this work, we systematically investigated the piezoelectric and photocatalytic properties of the hexagonal Janus In X ​ Y XY ( X X = S, Se, Te; Y Y = Cl, Br, I) monolayers (MLs) using first-principles calculations.

arxiv-2601-03476.title: Online Decision-Making Under Uncertainty for Vehicle-to-Building Systems
arxiv-2601-03476.creator: Rishav Sen, Yunuo Zhang, Fangqi Liu, Jose Paolo Talusan, Ava Pettet, Yoshinori Suzue, Ayan Mukhopadhyay, Abhishek Dubey
arxiv-2601-03476.description: Abstract . Vehicle-to-building (V2B) systems integrate physical infrastructures, such as smart buildings and electric vehicles (EVs) connected to chargers at the building, with digital control mechanisms to manage energy use. By utilizing EVs as flexible energy reservoirs, buildings can dynamically charge and discharge them to optimize energy use and cut costs under time-variable pricing and demand charge policies.

europmc-pmc5979609.creator: Kong DH, Kim YK, Kim MR, Jang JH, Lee S.
europmc-pmc5979609.description: Tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNFα) is a pro-inflammatory cytokine that triggers the expression of inflammatory molecules, including other cytokines and cell adhesion molecules. TNFα induces the expression of intercellular cell adhesion molecule-1 and vascular cell adhesion...

pmc-11328793.title: The complete chloroplast genome sequence and phylogenetic analysis of Tragopogon pratensis L. (Asteraceae)
pmc-11328793.creator: Xin-xue Zhang, Jianhu Zhang, Peng Wan, Hua Liu
pmc-11328793.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Currently, the phylogenetic relationships of Tragopogon pratensis Linnaeus (1753) remain unclear. This study presents the first report on the complete chloroplast genome of T. pratensis, which is a quadripartite structure with a length of 153,002 bp and containing a large single copy (LSC, 84,225 bp) region, a small single copy (SSC, 18,407 bp) region, a pair of inverted repeats (IR, 25,185 bp) regions.

pmc-11603818.title: Phylogenomics and adaptive evolution of hydrophytic umbellifers (tribe Oenantheae, Apioideae) revealed from chloroplast genomes
pmc-11603818.creator: Jun Wen, Jun-Wen Zhu, Xu-Dong Ma, Hui-Min Li, Bao-Cheng Wu, Wei Zhou, Jia-Xin Yang, Chun-Feng Song
pmc-11603818.description: BackgroundTribe Oenantheae consists mainly of aquatic species within the Apioideae. The unique morphology and habitat distinguish this group from other Apioideae groups. However, the genomic information of these group species has not been widely developed, and the molecular mechanisms of adaptive evolution remain unclear.

pmc-11672458.title: Investigating the Effects of Dietary Bile Acids on Production Performance and Lipid Metabolism in Late-Phase Laying Hens
pmc-11672458.creator: Longfei Wang, Kefeng Fan, Ronghui Xing, Jixue Yin, Xuemeng Si, Huaiyong Zhang, Yanqun Huang, Wen Chen, Jiakui Li
pmc-11672458.description: Simple SummaryIn the current study, the effect of dietary bile acids on production performance and lipid metabolism in late-laying hens was evaluated. The outcome showed that dietary supplemented with porcine-derived bile acids had no significant effect on production performance but increased total follicle number, relative eggshell weight, and yolk color. Of note, 95.

pmc-11679864.title: The Application and Optimisation of a Neural Network PID Controller for Trajectory Tracking Using UAVs
pmc-11679864.creator: Michał Siwek, Leszek Baranowski, Edyta Ładyżyńska-Kozdraś, Boyang Li, Chihyung Wen
pmc-11679864.description: This paper considers the problem of flying a UAV along a given trajectory at speeds close to the speed of sound and above. A novel pitch channel control system is presented using the example of a trajectory with rapid and large changes in flight height.

pmc-11709796.title: Deep Brain Stimulation of the Medial Septum Improves Okadaic Acid‐Induced Impairment of Spatial Working Memory and Restores the Cholinergic Activity in the Hippocampus
pmc-11709796.creator: MARIAM CHIGHLADZE, Khatuna Rusadze, Maia Burjanadze, Manana Dashniani, Lali Kruashvili
pmc-11709796.description: BackgroundThere is growing evidence from laboratory and clinical trials that deep brain stimulation (DBS) at memory associated structures enhances cognitive functions. Best site for memory enhancing‐DBS is still unclear. The medial septum (MS), the important modulator of the hippocampal neural network, might be a key target to accomplish therapeutic efficacy in memory impaired patients.

pmc-12418640.title: Effect of virtual reality on perioperative anxiety, stress and pain in total hip arthroplasty: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-12418640.creator: Saad Ahmed Moharam, Mohammed Said ElSharkawy, Ahmed Mohamed ELkashef, Mohamed Abdelhamed Romeih, Ahmed Osama Abd Rab El Rasool, Mostafa Mohamed Shaheen
pmc-12418640.description: BackgroundVirtual reality (VR) has shown promise as a nonpharmacological alternative to pharmaceutical pain relievers and anxiety medications in clinical trials by decreasing pain and anxiety in orthopedic surgeries. The aim of the study was to evaluate the impact of VR on these outcomes in individuals undergoing total hip arthroplasty (THA).

pmc-12475308.title: Progression of lumbar disc degeneration: A 14-year follow-up study examining Pfirrmann grading and its individual disc components
pmc-12475308.creator: Niko Murto, Teija Lund, Hannu Kautiainen, Katariina Luoma, Liisa Kerttula
pmc-12475308.description: BackgroundLumbar disc degeneration (LDD) is frequently evaluated using the Pfirrmann classification. While this composite grading system provides an overview of degeneration severity, it may oversimplify LDD by overlooking variability in individual disc components, reducing its effectiveness in longitudinal studies and constraining its applicability in artificial intelligence-based image analysis.

pmc-12972838.title: The Evolving Role of Ivabradine for Focal Atrial Tachycardia: A Systematic Review
pmc-12972838.creator: Haikal Balweel, Rifqi Rizkani Eri, Sania Zahrani, Kiara Hanna Quinncilla, Novaro Adeneur Tafriend, Agus Harsoyo
pmc-12972838.description: BackgroundIvabradine was initially introduced for heart failure and coronary artery disease patients, with its interesting feature of heart rate reduction without reducing heart contractility or blood pressure. In recent years, however, the use of ivabradine evolved for arrhythmia, including for focal atrial tachycardia (FAT).

pmc-13310792.title: Microenvironmental Cues That Regulate Cancer Cell Dormancy in Estrogen‐Receptor Positive and Triple‐Negative Breast Cancer Cell Lines
pmc-13310792.creator: Jinesh Maniar, Pulkit Datt, Prerana P. Dange, Vaishali Kailaje, Mithlesh Lakhera, Mansi Samarth, Tanuja Durve, Anushree Kadam, Khushboo A. Gandhi, Sudeep Gupta
pmc-13310792.description: The processes regulating cellular dormancy in tumor cells remain inadequately characterized. Further, there are very few models available that can recapitulate a dormancy‐like phenotype in vitro. In this study, we investigated the role of microenvironmental cues in inducing a dormancy‐like phenotype in estrogen receptor‐positive (MCF‐7) and triple‐negative (MDA‐MB‐231) breast cancer cell lines.

pmc-13384869.title: Safety and efficacy of DLL3 CAR-T cells armored with dnTGFBR2 in a subject with recurrent small-cell lung cancer: case report
pmc-13384869.creator: Chelsey M. Williams, Susanne M. Arnold, John L. Villano, Erika N. Amarilla Alonso, Christine F. Brainson, Paul O. Schwarzenberger, Sahista Vahora, Ayman Qasrawi, Reinhold Munker, B. Mark Evers, Zhonglin Hao
pmc-13384869.description: Novel CAR-T therapies targeting delta-like ligand 3 (DLL-3) are promising treatment strategies for individuals with extensive-stage SCLC (ES-SCLC). We report a case of a patient with ES-SCLC who received investigational therapy LB2102 off-label after becoming ineligible for a clinical trial. We described her positive, long-term response to treatment.

pmc-13668929.title: Persistent metabolic acidosis and frailty trajectories after kidney transplantation: a prospective cohort study
pmc-13668929.creator: Lucian Siriteanu, Andreea Covic, Călin Namolovan, Simona Mihaela Hogaș, Luminița Voroneanu, Adrian Covic
pmc-13668929.description: BackgroundMetabolic acidosis is common after kidney transplantation and has been linked to adverse graft outcomes, but its potential contribution to functional decline has not been prospectively evaluated. We investigated whether persistent metabolic acidosis is associated with longitudinal frailty trajectories in kidney transplant recipients.MethodsIn this prospective single-center cohort study, 239 adult kidney transplant recipients were followed for 24 months.
